spans.text: Having left for the stars before the Age of Sunderance could wipe their civilization away, the astral elves of Somnus Domina seek the mysteries of the cosmos. They initially prepared for space travel when they became aware of an anomaly on the edges of the universe—an anomaly now known to be the destruction of Luminal Prime and subsequent creation of Luminal Minus.

Astral soldiers serve the Exolunar Confederation, a union of spacefaring races who seek to unite those across the galaxy. They are peacekeepers and historians who have strict rules about interfering with planets that are not capable of fully comprehending the technology they use to travel the cosmos, but readily reach out to those they feel are ready. The Confederation is headed by a council which itself seats three astral elf sovereigns as its leaders, but offers seats to all species who wish to be among the voices heard.

Just as the framebilt would eventually construct DGRs, the astral elves created their own frame units long ago called lunar frames. Initially these were advanced magical constructs, but the methods of their creation grew more intricate and developed into the merging of science and arcana, leading to the units as they’re currently known. Frame pilots are trained specifically to use these machines, which are used when conflicts are inevitable or the threat of Outer Titans is present.

The armor of astral elves is made from a special alloy woven into thread-thin fibers. It is highly resistant and can negate kinetic energy striking it. The means of its construction is a closely guarded secret.
